scope: Moving diagonal coil handoff with shared prescribed switching time and voltages; no feedback

mechanical_properties.collision_scope: Exact bottom-film cylinder against a local infinite plane at the CAD playing-surface height; convex exterior mesh for the king. Board edges and concave piece-to-piece contact remain unqualified.
mechanical_properties.friction_scope: Single Coulomb coefficient from resting_friction_coefficient; separate static/kinetic friction and torsional/rolling resistance remain unqualified.
mechanical_properties.damping_scope: Soft-contact numerical damping only. No artificial airborne joint damping or material vibration model.

limitations: A short moving boundary crossing with a prescribed event, not position-triggered selection or controlled flight.
Uses the existing ideal opposite half-bus clamp until zero; diode drops, PWM, mutual inductance and bus transients remain unmodeled.
Off-channel back-EMF reaching a rail is explicitly rejected; induced diode re-conduction is not modeled.
Full physical CAD patch remains in force and Hall calculations even for unselected coils.
Position, angle and current use existing convergence limits; global Hall-field accuracy remains unqualified.
